page_title: EMP 1-1 BOL | Empoli v Bologna 25/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Federico La Penna has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+4' Flag up against Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
90+1' Emil Holm (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Sam Beukema (Bologna) but poses no threat.
88' Bologna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
84' Substitution. Benjamin Dominguez is replaced by Samuel Iling Junior (Bologna).
83' Roberto D'Aversa decides to make a substitution. Lorenzo Colombo will be replaced by Mattia De Sciglio (Empoli).
82' The substitution is prepared. Liberato Cacace (Empoli) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Giuseppe Pezzella.
81' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
80' Surely that's handball by one of the Empoli players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
80' A tremendous drive by Sam Beukema (Bologna) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach makes a brilliant save.
78' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) will miss the next game.
78' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
76' Vincenzo Italiano is forced to make a change. Charalampos Lykogiannis is unable to continue due to injury, Juan Miranda (Bologna) comes on.
75' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) replaces Nikola Moro.
74' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Jens Odgaard and he is replaced by Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna).
72' Alberto Grassi comes off the pitch to be replaced by Faustino Anjorin (Empoli).
70' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) hits the direct free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save.
70' Empoli are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
67' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
66' The game is interrupted now, Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
65' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 35:65.
60' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
58' Substitution. Liam Henderson makes his way off the pitch and Youssef Maleh (Empoli) comes on as his replacement.
55' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) sends a chip pass into the box, but Lukasz Skorupski is quickest to intercept the ball.
54' It seemed like Nikola Moro (Bologna) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
54' It looks like Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) saw red with that tackle. Federico La Penna won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
53' Great teamplay by Bologna as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
49' The ball goes out for a corner. Bologna can continue in their attacking effort.
48' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Vincenzo Italiano probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Thijs Dallinga (Bologna). He is replaced by Santiago Castro.
46' The whistle blows and Federico La Penna starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' A pass by Dan Ndoye (Bologna) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.

44' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Charalampos Lykogiannis. The score is now 1:1.
44' The linesman points to the corner flag, Bologna are going to take it.
43' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bologna.
40' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) is awarded a yellow card.
39' Empoli quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
38' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) and Sam Beukema matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
36' Liam Henderson (Empoli) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
34' It seemed like Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
33' A perfect long pass by Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) finds Emmanuel Gyasi. He latches on to the pass and continues his attacking run.
31' The resulting corner from Alberto Grassi (Empoli) is cleared.
30' 1:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
28' Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
28' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Empoli players have a reason to celebrate!
26' Wait! Referee Federico La Penna has indicated he is going to review the Empoli goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
26' Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
24' 1 - 0 Goal! Giuseppe Pezzella plays a pass to the feet of Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli), and he shoots into the bottom left corner from inside the box. It's 1:0.
23' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
18' Bologna control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
14' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
13' Federico La Penna blows his whistle and it's Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
6' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
3' The free kick into the box finds Jhon Lucumi (Bologna), who heads the ball towards the top of the net, but the keeper pulls off a fantastic reflex save. Great goalkeeping skills.
3' Bologna have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Bologna will have the kick-off.
Federico La Penna is the one to supervise the game today.
